name: maviapi
description: The unofficial API for any website, as MCP tools: search a catalog of hosted JSON APIs for sites with no official API (travel, shopping, maps, events), read each endpoint's schema and call it, or name a missing site and get its API built. Tools include search_apis, get_api, call_api, create_api, get_build_status and get_changelog. Works on a shared demo key out of the box; set MAVIAPI_API_KEY to use your own key. The server returns data only and never acts on target sites. A hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint is also available at https://mcp.maviapi.com/mcp.

MAVIAPI_API_KEY.description: Your maviapi API key. Optional: without it the server uses the shared demo key.
